unique_tasks: Do the followings: 1. If the bottle cap is facing left, rotate the bottle 180 degrees. 2. Pick up the bottle. 3. Twist off the bottle cap if the bottle has a cap. 4. Put the bottle into the box on the left. 5. Put the cap into the box on the right. If the bottle cap falls onto the table, pick it up. 6. Return to home position.

interpretation_limits: Unique counts count each repository once; weighted exposure is not additional collected data.
The Hub metadata proves dataset contents, not that every frame was sampled equally during training.
Repository names are not used as success labels.
